about: Corrections and additions to data/atlas.json, kept here so they survive a rebuild with tools/build_atlas.py. 'fix' changes fields of existing records (kind, cls = main pose class, alt = other pose classes the sculpture can also stand for). 'records' are new models (mesh m/<id>.js, thumbnail t/<id>.webp). A new record is skipped if atlas.json already has its id.
